import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 20;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 400;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 200000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;

    static int[][] grid = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] dist_from_source = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] bfs_queue = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[][] graph = new int[MAX_NODES][MAX_NODES];
    static int n, total_nodes, time_limit;
    static String row_input;
    static int source_r, source_c;
    static int[] dr = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dc = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, capacity, next;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c, int nxt) {
            from = f; to = t; capacity = c; next = nxt;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int edge_count;
    static int source_node, sink_node;
    static List<Integer> husks = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> reapers = new ArrayList<>();

    static int pos(int r, int c) {
        return (r - 1) * n + c;
    }

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= n && c >= 1 && c <= n && grid[r][c] != -1;
    }

    static void build_graph() {
        total_nodes = n * n;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_NODES; j++) {
                graph[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= n; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; c++) {
                if (grid[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int u = pos(r, c);
                graph[u][u] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nr = r + dr[d];
                    int nc = c + dc[d];
                    if (valid(nr, nc)) {
                        int v = pos(nr, nc);
                        graph[u][v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute_shortest_from_source() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; i++) dist_from_source[i] = INF;
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        int start = pos(source_r, source_c);
        dist_from_source[start] = 0;
        bfs_queue[rear++] = start;

        while (front < rear) {
            int cur = bfs_queue[front++];
            for (int nxt = 1; nxt <= total_nodes; nxt++) {
                if (graph[cur][nxt] == 1 && dist_from_source[nxt] > dist_from_source[cur] + 1) {
                    dist_from_source[nxt] = dist_from_source[cur] + 1;
                    bfs_queue[rear++] = nxt;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void all_pairs_floyd() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= total_nodes; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_nodes; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= total_nodes; j++) {
                    if (graph[i][k] != -1 && graph[k][j] != -1) {
                        if (graph[i][j] == -1 || graph[i][j] > graph[i][k] + graph[k][j]) {
                            graph[i][j] = graph[i][k] + graph[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void init_flow_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edge_count = 0;
        source_node = 0;
        sink_node = husks.size() / 3 + reapers.size() / 3 + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < husks.size(); i += 3) {
            int id = i / 3 + 1;
            int cnt = husks.get(i + 2);
            edges[edge_count] = new Edge(source_node, id, cnt, head[source_node]);
            head[source_node] = edge_count++;
            edges[edge_count] = new Edge(id, source_node, 0, head[id]);
            head[id] = edge_count++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < reapers.size(); i += 3) {
            int id = husks.size() / 3 + i / 3 + 1;
            int cnt = reapers.get(i + 2);
            edges[edge_count] = new Edge(id, sink_node, cnt, head[id]);
            head[id] = edge_count++;
            edges[edge_count] = new Edge(sink_node, id, 0, head[sink_node]);
            head[sink_node] = edge_count++;
        }

        int src_pos = pos(source_r, source_c);
        for (int i = 0; i < husks.size(); i += 3) {
            int hr = husks.get(i), hc = husks.get(i + 1), hcnt = husks.get(i + 2);
            int hp = pos(hr, hc);
            for (int j = 0; j < reapers.size(); j += 3) {
                int rr = reapers.get(j), rc = reapers.get(j + 1), rcnt = reapers.get(j + 2);
                int rp = pos(rr, rc);
                if (graph[hp][rp] != -1 && graph[hp][rp] <= time_limit) {
                    if (graph[hp][rp] < dist_from_source[rp]) {
                        edges[edge_count] = new Edge(i/3+1, husks.size()/3+j/3+1, INF, head[i/3+1]);
                        head[i/3+1] = edge_count++;
                        edges[edge_count] = new Edge(husks.size()/3+j/3+1, i/3+1, 0, head[husks.size()/3+j/3+1]);
                        head[husks.size()/3+j/3+1] = edge_count++;
                    } else if (graph[hp][rp] == dist_from_source[rp]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nrr = rr + dr[d], nrc = rc + dc[d];
                            if (valid(nrr, nrc)) {
                                int np = pos(nrr, nrc);
                                if (graph[hp][np] == graph[hp][rp] - 1 && graph[hp][np] < dist_from_source[np]) {
                                    edges[edge_count] = new Edge(i/3+1, husks.size()/3+j/3+1, INF, head[i/3+1]);
                                    head[i/3+1] = edge_count++;
                                    edges[edge_count] = new Edge(husks.size()/3+j/3+1, i/3+1, 0, head[husks.size()/3+j/3+1]);
                                    head[husks.size()/3+j/3+1] = edge_count++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] level = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] queue_bfs = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        queue_bfs[rear++] = source_node;
        level[source_node] = 0;

        while (front < rear) {
            int u = queue_bfs[front++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].next) {
                int v = edges[e].to;
                if (level[v] == -1 && edges[e].capacity > 0) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    if (v == sink_node) return true;
                    queue_bfs[rear++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink_node) return flow;
        for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = edges[e].next) {
            int v = edges[e].to;
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && edges[e].capacity > 0) {
                int f = dfs(v, Math.min(flow, edges[e].capacity));
                if (f > 0) {
                    edges[e].capacity -= f;
                    edges[e^1].capacity += f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int[] tempHead = head.clone();
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, head, 0, head.length);
            while (true) {
                int f = dfs(source_node, INF);
                if (f == 0) break;
                result += f;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int compute_solution() {
        grid[source_r][source_c] = 0;
        build_graph();
        compute_shortest_from_source();
        grid[source_r][source_c] = -1;
        build_graph();
        all_pairs_floyd();
        init_flow_graph();
        return max_flow();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        time_limit = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        husks.clear();
        reapers.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(grid[i], 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            row_input = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (row_input.charAt(j) == 'Y') grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (row_input.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    source_r = i; source_c = j+1;
                    grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                }
                else if (row_input.charAt(j) > '0' && row_input.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    husks.add(i);
                    husks.add(j+1);
                    husks.add(row_input.charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            row_input = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (row_input.charAt(j) > '0' && row_input.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    reapers.add(i);
                    reapers.add(j+1);
                    reapers.add(row_input.charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_solution());
    }
}
